== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine) with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809221059/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/r4m9.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine) (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/3f/Premiere-D-r4m9-PC-Errata-disc.gif Internet Archive item].
